mapper.select: SELECT id, name, spec, unit, price, stock, usage_desc, status, create_time, update_time FROM medicine WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT i.quantity FROM prescription_item i JOIN prescription p ON p.id = i.prescription_id WHERE i.medicine_id = #{medicineId} AND p.status = 'paid' ORDER BY p.id ASC, i.id ASC FOR UPDATE
